title: Command Block Locator
description: Helps you locate executing command blocks
body:
**Command Block Locator**

Ever have a running command block you forgot where you placed, and its messing with your minecraft world? Well with this plugin you can locate where those command blocks are and what command they are running!

Run the command `/cbl toggle` and the server will message you every command block command that is executed and where the command block is!

This command is only for operators or users with the `cbl.toggle` permission.
